question: Which continent will suffer the most from global warming in terms of the number of people affected?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Asia; oceans will rise**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Asia is the continent most likely to suffer the most significant effects of global warming** in terms of the number of people affected due to the following reasons:
 
• Asia **has densely populated coastal areas**, including major cities s**uch as Mumbai, Jakarta, Shanghai, and Dhaka. **
 
 
• **Rising sea levels threaten to displace millions of people in these regions.**
 
 
 
• Asia **experiences frequent cyclones, monsoons, and floods**, which are expected to become more intense due to global warming.
 
• Asia** has the largest population of any continent, **and a significant portion of this population lives in vulnerable areas, amplifying the number of people affected.
 
• **Many Asian countries depend on agricultur**e, which is** highly sensitive to changing rainfall patterns, droughts, and temperature extremes caused by climate change.**
